name: Sinobo Group Co., Ltd. (中赫集团有限公司)
note: Beijing conglomerate (real-estate and mining investment, asset management, sports), sponsor website sinobo.com. Held jointly by chairman Zhou Jinhui (周金辉) and Li Caixia (李彩霞) per company-registration data reported by Sohu/ITBEAR (2025-06-20). Owner of Beijing Guoan FC: the club is listed under the group's businesses (集团业务) on sinobo.com/ga.
